title: bl_procs reads a plugin-data distill as a hook run, so selfcheck orphans and procs do not list it while it waits for the distill lock in the main checkout
goal: bl_procs.hook_logs includes the plugin data query log's distill.log (ql_base.places()[0] / distill.log) when CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is the plugin's, so a plugin-mode distill that ST-7agdvwth starts in the main checkout is read as a session-end hook run, not an orphan, by selfcheck orphans and backlog.py procs

run:
import os,sys,tempfile;os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA"]=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"]=os.getcwd();sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_base as q,bl_procs as p
log=os.path.realpath(str(q.places()[0]/"distill.log"));ok=log in p.hook_logs(p.checkouts("."))
print("plugin-data distill.log read as a hook log:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
